_comment: ZeRO-3 for a Thinker-Talker omni model. The 'auto' values are a HuggingFace Trainer convention, not a DeepSpeed feature: Trainer substitutes its own TrainingArguments before DeepSpeed sees this file. Launch with raw deepspeed.initialize() and 'auto' is a parse error.
_zero_optimization_stage_comment: Stage 3 shards parameters as well as optimizer states and gradients, at 1.5x the communication of stage 2 (3-psi vs 2-psi). Worth it here because an omni model is FOUR models resident at once -- language backbone, vision encoder, audio encoder, speech decoder -- and the activations from two simultaneous token streams need every spare byte.
_zero_optimization_gather_comment: Required. Without it the checkpoint is written as shards that from_pretrained cannot load, which you discover after the run finishes.
_zero_optimization_offload_comment: Uncomment to trade speed for VRAM if 3B still will not fit. CPU offload costs roughly 2-3x step time over PCIe. Try shortening the clip first -- audio contributes 25 tokens per second on top of the video, so clip length buys more than offload does.
